broad_fields_needing_expansion.needed: Separate supported opcode/operand decoding, predicates, native control bits and semantic data dependencies; current bounded decoders do not define a full ISA.
Index by instruction class and format, then state resource sharing and mutually exclusive effective/decomposed timing.
Index matrix shape/type/layout and split functional mappings from private pipeline organization and arithmetic candidates.
Define queue entry unit, scope, admission, release, ownership and merging; counts of operations/sectors/lines/consumers are not interchangeable.
List legal carveout, selected runtime carveout, usable capacity and reserved overhead; published128KiB and queried100KiB are different facts.
Specify set count per slice versus global count and enforce total set*way*line*slices capacity; unsliced test cache omits actual topology.
Identify barrier family, participant granularity, arrival bandwidth, generation lifetime, drain conditions and resume behavior.

redundancy_and_doublecount_risks.issue: T007 andT015 have the same name; T018 is a tensor-specific member. Give class/scope keys and alias relationship, never add all three as separate waits.
Class result latency can already include MOVM/matrix result latency; effective recurrence also includes issue/wakeup. Choose one timing contract per opcode.
The measured28cycle direct LDS recurrence includes return/wakeup/issue; adding all decomposed path terms to28 double-counts.
Partition configuration, usable L1 capacity and sets/ways are linked constraints; preserve separate definitions but derive one from the others where justified.
Coalescing, service splitting, broadcasts and returned-value assembly are different stages; avoid charging sector/package work twice.

conditional_details_not_required_at_fixe.condition: Clocks and thermal operating point are controlled and measured; retain observed drift bounds.
Supported allocation/address footprint shows no consequential translation error; otherwise F043–47/T024–26 become necessary.

conditional_details_not_required_at_fixe.detail: Every CUDA/PTX numerical opcode and SFU
conditional_details_not_required_at_fixe.condition: Fixed BF16-GEMM path executes only recovered native instruction families; exclude unsupported workloads.
Working-set/reuse regime does not induce consequential evictions; a sensitivity-tested bounded policy may suffice, but cannot claim physical identification.

complete_gemm_scope_gaps: Configured2SMs and2contexts do not reproduce170SMs and saved11resident-small-CTAs; scaling/resource placement must be validated.
No executable native instruction fetch/decode cache or full register-bank/collector routing despite parameters present.
Global address, staging and output scheduling are simplified; not complete original native hotloop timing.
Memory backend delays/overlap and slice/channel mapping remain hypotheses, preventing current full-hardware timing claim.

FullGPU instruction/format families, special-function units, texture/surface machinery, atomic/reduction protocols, device communication and graphics are excluded; this audit does not certify a completeGPU.
